name: daq_timing_and_triggers
description: Input-only tour of the timing functions of the NI DAQ; nothing needs to be wired and no output is driven. The board's internal 100 kHz timebase stands in for an external signal: its period, pulse width and edge-to-edge time are measured, it clocks an acquisition and triggers one with pre-trigger samples. Then port 0 is sampled as a digital waveform and an encoder is followed for a moment (it reads 0 degrees with nothing connected).
